warnings: This is a biostimulant study with algal extracts, not a CO2 study - treatment/control definitions need to be adjusted
Multiple algal extract types tested (4 species) at multiple doses (3 levels each) - factorial design with 12 biostimulant treatments vs 1 control
Seed yield reported as g/plant which is the PRIMARY OUTCOME for this meta-analysis
Tables contain both morphological and chemical data - need to distinguish primary yield outcomes from secondary chemical constituents
Control is 'distilled water' treatment, not untreated - clearly defined
Data reported as Mean ± SD format throughout tables
WARNING: SCANNED PDF - Text may have OCR errors
WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: values are given as Mean ± SD
recon.control_definition: Distilled water (0 g/L) as foliar spray
recon.treatment_definition: Four algal extracts (Spirulina platensis, Chlorella vulgaris, Amphora coffeaeformis, Scenedesmus obliquus) at three doses each (1, 2, 3 g/L)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: None - control clearly identified as 0 g/L treatment
recon.sample_size_source: Complete Randomized Block Design (CRBD) with three replicates
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract seed yield (SEYI) data from Table 1. Control is 0 g/L treatment (26.1 ± 0.8 g/plant). Extract each of the 12 biostimulant treatments vs this single control. Use SD values as reported. Note this is a biostimulant study using algal extracts as foliar applications, not a CO2 study.
